chunks: About qazz that a woman wears in ihram, he said: “There is no harm. What is disliked is pure silk.”

key_terms.الْإِحْرَامِ: the state of consecration for hajj or 'umrah
key_terms.الْقَزِّ: qazz; a silk-blend fabric referred to in the ruling
key_terms.الْمَرْأَةُ: the woman subject of the legal ruling
key_terms.لَا بَأْسَ: there is no harm; indicating permissibility

ai.seo_question: Can a woman wear qazz in the state of ihram?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling about what a woman may wear in the state of ihram. It states that wearing qazz is not problematic, while what is considered disliked is pure silk.
